spell1.text: Your incantations sound like a goose reading a tax form.

spell2.text: I've seen more magical talent in a damp sock.

fash1.text: Those robes look like they lost a duel with a laundry cauldron.

fash2.text: Did you dress in the dark, or does the dark dress you?

int1.text: Talking to you is like reading a book with all the words removed.

int2.text: Your thoughts are so slow they arrive by owl.

lin1.text: Your bloodline is so thin it's mostly apology.

diet1.text: You smell like the cafeteria. All of it.

relic1.text: A phoenix you can only cast once you're dead? Practical as a chocolate cauldron.

comebacks.spellcraft: Still, my spells finish. Yours are still in committee.
comebacks.fashion: At least my robes fit. Yours were tailored for your ego, and it's still growing.
comebacks.intellect: Then you'll finally have something you can read.
comebacks.lineage: At least mine apologizes. Yours just sends invoices.
comebacks.diet: It builds character. You should try a bowl.
comebacks.relic: Practical? My dear, this is a university.

gilt_roasts.text: The Gilt line has produced eleven Archmages. Yours has produced a rumor.
Your so-called thaumaturgy is an insult to the very concept of intention.
One shudders to imagine what tailor would consent to clothe such ambition.
I have reviewed your academic record. It was brief. It was blank.
This Council will not be lectured on cuisine by a creature raised on sludge.

gilt_flex.text: Behold — the Radiant Resuscitation of the Eternal Sun! Let it be known the Sunspire fears no death!

insider_line: Wonderful. Do let us know how it works after you die.
gilt_office_lines: Ah. A student. During office hours. How novel.
You'll want to know about the Sunspire, of course. Everyone does.
Eleven Archmages in the Gilt line. Eleven. I have their portraits. In the stairwell. In order of height.
My great-grandmother once out-argued a thunderstorm. It apologised. In writing.
People ask me, 'Ostentia, how do you maintain such radiance?' And I say: discipline. And gold leaf.
The Phoenix? Oh, you've heard. Yes. It restores the caster entirely. In a pillar of holy fire.
The circumstances of casting are... specific. Don't concern yourself with the circumstances.
The cafeteria? I am told there is one. I have never been. I have a man.
Budget reform is a fascinating little idea. Like a kitten. Best kept small, and out of the Council chamber.
My tower is the most secure on campus, naturally. Nothing has ever happened there.
You may go. No — stay. I wasn't finished being admired.
Very well. You may tell your friends you spoke with me. They won't believe you. That's the point.
gilt_incident_line: ...Was that my tower? No. It was not. Nothing happens at my tower. Do continue listening.

snobs.name: Bartleby Fenwick-Throop
snobs.you_say: Nice hat. Did it come with a refund?
snobs.they_say: Then you'll finally have something you can read.

snobs.name: Ophelia Starchwell
snobs.you_say: I'd roast your robes, but the laundry cauldron already did.
snobs.they_say: At least my robes fit. Yours were tailored for your ego, and it's still growing.

snobs.name: Mortimer Vane-Vane
snobs.they_say: Your bloodline is so thin it's mostly apology.

snobs.name: Clementine Quillfeather
snobs.you_say: Is that a thought on your face, or a rash?
snobs.they_say: Your thoughts are so slow they arrive by owl.

duelists.name: Percival Snoot
duelists.title: Second-year, Department of Being Correct
duelists.win_line: This is a clerical error. I shall be filing a grievance with myself.
duelists.lose_line: Run along. The sludge is getting cold.

duelists.name: Lady Cressida Vane
duelists.title: Fourth-year, heir to a modest fortune of immodest size
duelists.win_line: How dreadfully common of you to win.
duelists.lose_line: Do give my regards to the gruel.

student_lines: Did you hear? Classes are optional again. They were always optional. It is just nice to hear.
The sludge today was a sort of... beige. Last week it was a sort of beige too, but louder.
I tried to read a book once. The book read me first. I don't want to talk about it.
Gilt holds office hours on the hour. Mostly so people can watch her hold them.
Mother Ladle has been here thirty years. Nobody knows what she ladled before the sludge.
I am majoring in Merit Points. Minor in Grandstanding.
ladle_lines: Don't tell me what it's for, love. I don't want to know. I know.
Thirty years ladling this. You get to recognise a face that wants something better.
Eat something first. No? Then buy something.
The Archmages had lobster again. I could smell it through two floors. Go on, then.
notices_base: COUNCIL NOTICE — The cafeteria budget remains under review. It has been under review for eleven years. The review is going well.
ARCHMAGE GILT will hold office hours at the Sunspire Pavilion from :00 to :30, every hour, so that she may be consulted.
LOST: one sense of proportion. Last seen near the Sunspire. If found, do not return.

helmets.name: Iron bucket helmets & neck collars
helmets.effect: Crowbar takedowns fail (CLONK). Busts still work.
helmets.notice: The Sunspire is pleased to announce the acquisition of forty iron bucket helmets, for no particular reason.

trueSight.name: Lantern-eye true-sight over-patrol
trueSight.effect: Shadows stop hiding you. Extra wardens. Smoke and steam still block sight.
trueSight.notice: The Sunspire announces a generous staffing initiative: additional night wardens, each fitted with lantern-eye lenses. Unrelatedly, nothing has happened.

heatRunes.name: Heated floor runes + spiked cleats
heatRunes.effect: Grease on a rune becomes burning slick. Guards no longer slip.
heatRunes.notice: Floor heating has been installed throughout the Sunspire, for comfort. Staff are reminded to wear the provided spiked cleats at all times. For comfort.

sap.name: Anti-magic sap on keyholes
sap.effect: Mage Hand fizzles on locks. Pick them in person.
sap.notice: The Sunspire has treated all keyholes with a decorative sap. It is decorative.

earmuffs.name: Enchanted noise-canceling earmuffs
earmuffs.effect: Guards are deaf — to distractions and to your sprinting.
earmuffs.notice: Sunspire staff will now be issued enchanted earmuffs, to protect them from the noise of absolutely nothing happening.

shop.name: Smoke Bomb
shop.desc: 3×3 cloud, blocks sight 8s. Douse → wet fog. Freeze → ice-block seal.

shop.name: Clockwork Noisemaker
shop.desc: Timer 15s–5min ([ and ]). Radius-10 noise. The Alibi Engine's plant.

shop.name: Ice-Rune Charge
shop.desc: Fires when its ice melts: 3 min, or 45s on a heated floor. Cannot be disarmed.

shop.name: Wire-snips (3 uses)
shop.desc: Cut physical wires; disable a Revealed rune housing.
